NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT — UNICODE TEST

1. Parties & Definitions
This Non-Disclosure Agreement (“Agreement”) is executed between Alpha Tech Ltd. (represented by Dr. Müller) and Beta Solutions S.A.S. (represented by M. René François).

2. Financial Terms: €50,000 & ¥5,000,000
All penalties for unauthorized disclosure shall equal €50,000 (EUR) or ¥5,000,000 (JPY) per occurrence.
Special provisions include non-breaking spaces (here is one) and mathematical symbols: ∀x ∈ Secrets, x is protected.

3. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of Switzerland (Canton of Zürich).
